messages:
alice (oncall): paging: high GPU queue growth in ap-south1, autoscaler failing to add nodes. alert: gpu_pool_utilization > 95% for 6m :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 - ap-south1 GPU allocation failures (autoscale). Pager notified: alice (oncall)
alice (oncall): seeing repeated quotaDenied errors from GCP when attempting to create gpu instances. logs: `quotaExceeded: region: asia-south1, metric: accelerator_cores`
ryan (infra): confirming — cloud-ops returned 403-ish quota denial at 2026-04-23T07:18Z. Autoscaler attempted 4 scaleups, all rejected.
nina (sre): impact: request queue > 1200 pending, 95th latency for hosted API spiked to 18s, some customer retries observed. adding customer-impact tag.
sam (support): we got two support tickets complaining about degraded embeddings throughput for customers in APAC. CS is aware.
alice (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestions? can we reroute to eu-west1 or enable burst pool?
ryan (infra): options: 1) manual failover -> route new allocation traffic to eu-west1 (config change) 2) request emergency quota increase with GCP (slow) 3) shrink model config to non-GPU variant for low-priority tenants 4) enable warm-pool in other region and burst route.
nina (sre): actioning quick reroute for new requests to eu-west1. Will leave existing sessions pinned. Patch in router: `if region == ap-south1 and queue_len > 500 -> route eu-west1`.
alice (oncall): do it. post PR and deploy. please include a rollback plan.
ryan (infra): PR opened and merged: https://git.company/repo/infra-router/pulls/2123 - deploying canary to 10% traffic to verify.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra-router v2.14.3 -> canary(10%).
nina (sre): canary looks healthy so far. 502s down from 8%->2% in canary slice. CPU on eu-west1 increasing as expected.
ops-bot: autoscaler attempted 3 more node provisions; still quotaDenied from GCP at 07:29Z. Quota headline: "accelerator count quota" at account level.
sam (support): posting to customers: "We are aware of degraded performance in APAC and are routing new requests to a secondary region. Existing sessions may see increased latency. We're working on restoring capacity."
alice (oncall): build runbook item: if queue stays > 800 after 20m, enable temporary throttling for background jobs and low-priority queues.
ryan (infra): started throttling low-priority jobs: set rate limit to 30% for batch jobs. patch applied to queue manager.
nina (sre): monitoring backlog delta. good signal: pending queue stopped growing after reroute, now slowly draining at eu-west1 capacity. still ~650 stuck pinned to ap-south1 where nodes couldn't be added.
sam (support): customers asking ETA. what to tell them?
alice (oncall): ETA: mitigation in place, degradation limited to existing sessions pinned to APAC, expected steady drain 30-45m. update in 30m or if conditions change.
ryan (infra): opened GCP support case (case: 5432167) and escalated — provided logs showing repeated quotaDenied errors. ETA from GCP unknown, requesting emergency quota bump.
ops-bot: Note: there is a pending scheduled maintenance in ap-south1 for provider side – this might affect allocation. link: https://status.gcp.com/incident/abc123
nina (sre): plan B if GCP can't bump: provision smaller instances with fractional GPU (if supported) or move affected Dedicated pools to another region as a last resort. both have customer SLA implications.
alice (oncall): assigned to oncall to keep monitoring and coordinate customer comms. ryan -> continue escalation with GCP. nina -> keep a close watch on queue and failures. sam -> update customers and post on status page.
ryan (infra): GCP replied: they see a temporary enforcement due to partner fair-share limits, suggested 2-4 hour window to restore quotas. pushing hard for emergency.
sam (support): status page note published: "Investigating GPU allocation failures in ap-south1 causing degraded throughput. Mitigation: routing new requests to eu-west1. Impact: ongoing for pinned sessions. Next update in 30m."
nina (sre): added temporary metric alert: if ap-south1 pending queue > 500 for >15m, trigger oncall-2.
alice (oncall): customer-facing update ready, will send to PMs and CS: "We've routed new requests to a fallback region; pinned sessions in APAC may still be affected while we wait on quota recovery or have to migrate workloads. We're prioritizing high-SLA tenants for immediate migration."
ryan (infra): manual migration prep: snapshot KV caches for pinned sessions is risky; decide to let sessions drain unless a specific customer asks for migration.
nina (sre): queue decreased to 420 after 25m. latency trending down. continuing monitoring.
ops-bot: Autoscaler logs: last provision attempt 07:47Z -> `400 quotaExceeded accelerator_cores` -> backoff.
sam (support): CS requests list of impacted customers for targeted outreach. attaching current list to ticket.
alice (oncall): compiling list now. prioritizing enterprise tenants and customers with active incidents.
ryan (infra): GCP finally approved a limited quota bump for critical projects at 08:03Z (temporary +12 GPUs). provisioning started and nodes coming up.
nina (sre): new nodes registered in ap-south1, backlog draining faster. marking mitigation step: temporary quota applied.
ops-bot: Incident update: temporary capacity restored via emergency quota + routing. ongoing: follow-up to request permanent quota increase and review regional fallbacks.
alice (oncall): postmortem owners: ryan (infra) to handle quota process and automation to detect provider-side fairshare, nina (sre) to own routing fallback runbook, sam (support) to draft customer messaging.
sam (support): will send customer follow-up summarizing impact and steps taken.
alice (oncall): closing bridge in 20m unless regression. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
